lines.4: 「We got a little too wrapped up in talking.」
lines.5: 「If we go change now, we'll run out of time.」
lines.10: 「You promise to dance with anyone else?」
lines.13: 「Two lonely souls together. May I have this dance, miss?」
lines.14: 「W-well... it'd be kind of sad to have no memory of the folk dance at all.」
lines.15: 「If that's the reason, then I'll dance with you!」
lines.18: 「If you're going to invite me like that, then lead!」
lines.24: 「This outfit is hard to move in!」
lines.29: We practiced, making mistakes on both sides.
lines.30: After a while, we started to look halfway decent.
lines.32: 「It's a simple dance. You'd better get used to it.」
lines.33: Once we did, we had enough breathing room to talk while dancing.
lines.35: 「I'd die of embarrassment if anyone saw us like this.」
lines.36: 「A butler and a maid dancing together probably is a weird sight.」
lines.38: 「A lot of the irritation I'd been carrying is gone.」
lines.39: 「Yeah. I'm grateful I don't have to get depressed every time I see your face anymore.」
lines.40: 「Thinking about it now, staying mad and dragging a fight out forever is...」
lines.43: 「Are you actually trying to start another fight?」
lines.45: 「But now that we've made up, you've been promoted from 'guy who pisses me off' to 'schoolmate,' you know?」
lines.47: 「Now I can really let you have it whenever you're being sloppy.」
lines.49: 「When we were fighting, I mostly just ignored you.」
lines.50: 「But schoolmates should call each other out when their habits are a mess.」
lines.52: I remembered the terror of that morning when I'd been trapped between Otome and Konoe.
lines.53: And now I had to live with that all the time?
lines.55: 「All you have to do is get your act together.」
lines.56: 「I will! I worked hard today, didn't I?」
lines.57: 「Yeah... Your help with the club really did save us.」
lines.59: 「I AM grateful, so I'll point out every sloppy habit of yours from now on.」
lines.61: If Konoe started keeping tabs on me too, on top of Otome, my nerves wouldn't survive.
lines.62: 「Don't make weird noises! You're ruining the mood!」
lines.65: 「Looking at that dopey face should make me sick of you,」
lines.66: 「but somehow I just can't leave you alone.」
lines.69: 「Um... the folk dance ended a while ago.」
lines.72: 「Aw, Yoppi. You weren't supposed to tell them.」
lines.74: 「Ah... um, this isn't what it looks like!」
lines.75: 「Konoe just wouldn't let go of my hand!」
lines.82: 「I'm way cooler than him... Foolish woman.」
lines.83: 「Uh, sorry. Your face is scary too, so could you stop?」
lines.84: 「Inori, something smells fishy about those two. It's giving my delicate body goosebumps!」
lines.87: 「Perfectly. I can even do double recording.」
lines.88: 「Now everyone got the wrong idea because of YOU!」
lines.90: 「Look. My hand's soaked with your sweat! You were gripping it THAT hard.」
lines.91: 「Ghh...! D-do normal people SAY things like that!?」
lines.96: 「Maybe we should tease her some more. Until a blood vessel bursts.」
lines.97: 「A-are you in a bad mood or something?」
lines.99: It had been one hectic Sports and Martial Arts Festival.
lines.100: But... I guess this wasn't so bad either.
